pr_title: Fix a performance regression when duplicating a node
pr_body:
@Calinou reported a performance regression when duplicating empty node so I fixed it by moving all property duplication away from ```duplicate```to ```_duplicate_properties``` function so that we wouldn't loop through them twice. 

Fixes: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/91230

Duplicating empty node now takes on my Macbook 1336 milliseconds compared to before (2246 milliseconds).
```
Iteration 0: 60.805 MB
Iteration 1: 60.811 MB
Iteration 2: 60.819 MB
Iteration 3: 60.839 MB
Iteration 4: 60.879 MB
Iteration 5: 60.958 MB
Iteration 6: 61.115 MB
Iteration 7: 61.430 MB
Iteration 8: 62.090 MB
Iteration 9: 63.412 MB
Iteration 10: 65.923 MB
Iteration 11: 71.076 MB
Iteration 12: 81.382 MB
Iteration 13: 101.994 MB
Iteration 14: 143.217 MB
Iteration 15: 225.661 MB
Done running in 1336 milliseconds.
```

~~Edit: Should also fix https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/91461~~

See which "email" you have configured currently: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/91329.patch
Ah yes, I pushed from my work laptop since it was the only thing that I had with. I’ll change it.

@KoBeWi I guess, this pr should be merged first:
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/91677
@MangiameliFabio what is the content type? If the variable type is Node have you checked that Nodepath is correct?

We are using a typed array of string. When you follow the if case in your code you can see that `p_copy->set(name, value);` is not called because `arr.get_typed_builtin() == Variant::OBJECT` will be false.

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e96ad5af98547df71b50c4c4695ac348638113e0/scene/main/node.cpp#L2895-L2909
Aight I see. Does your solution work with variables with node type? If not then you should modify your solution to work with both (add ```p_copy->set``` back into if and else if statements).

Yes, node type is also working. `p_copy->set(name, value)` needs to be executed every time like it was before this PR. We are using the code from my first comment in our game Halls of Torment and didn't experience any further problems with duplication. (We are duplicating a lot :P) 

See this commit, `p_copy->set(name, value)` is out of the if bracket
https://github.com/ChasingCarrots/godot/commit/92939f2e97c56f534df5a2cb5add9383c3be1a77
@MangiameliFabio huh, I guess there's no longer a purpose for if & else if statements. Just make a new pr I guess :)

I discussed this a bit further and am unsure what the correct fix is. Executing `p_copy->set(name, value)` outside the if statemnt could possible set the value in to many occasions. So I won't open a pr as I simply don't know enough about the whole system.

The behavior used to be your way where there weren't any if-statements and it would just set a value. My guess is that it might have something todo with this pr: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/92095 for making if/else if unnecessary.

I'd say that it is worth it to open up a pr if:

a) it fixes issues with non node type typed arrays

b)  no other issues are present with other data types, resources and nodes.
@KoBeWi could you take a look at this? I don't currently have that much time to look at this myself.
